name: whatsapp-mcp
description: Connect Claude to your WhatsApp. Search contacts, read chat history, and send replies — all local on your Mac.
long_description: WhatsApp MCP for macOS reads messages from your local WhatsApp database, so they never leave your machine. Search contacts, list recent chats, read message history, and catch up on unread messages — no QR scan, no Node.js, no Python install. Sending is optional: when you want the model to send replies, start the included WhatsApp Web bridge and scan one QR code.

tools.name: whatsapp_status
tools.description: Check WhatsApp connection status. Returns a QR code if one is needed for sending.

tools.name: whatsapp_search_contacts
tools.description: Search WhatsApp contacts by name or phone number.

tools.name: whatsapp_list_chats
tools.description: List recent WhatsApp chats ordered by last message time, with unread counts.

tools.name: whatsapp_get_messages
tools.description: Get messages from a specific chat, filtered by date range.

tools.name: whatsapp_search_messages
tools.description: Full-text search across all WhatsApp message history.

tools.name: whatsapp_unread
tools.description: Summary of all unread WhatsApp messages, grouped by chat.

tools.name: whatsapp_send
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message. Requires the bridge to be connected.

tools.name: whatsapp_incoming
tools.description: Get recent incoming WhatsApp messages from the live connection.

whatsapp_bridge_url.title: WhatsApp Bridge URL
whatsapp_bridge_url.description: URL of the WhatsApp Web bridge, only needed for sending messages. Defaults to http://localhost:3010.
